column1: # The published composition of the all-days feature list after correlation pruning,
# transcribed from the bar labels of HCS-proc's files/feature_categories_barplot.png
# (github.com/NIB-SI/HCS-proc, MIT). Every bar segment there is labelled with its count,
# so the figure is a complete table, not an approximation.
# That figure is generated by scripts/categorization/count_feature_types.py from the
# feature-selection output - after correlation pruning and before the missing-data filter
# the dimension-reduction step applies - which is exactly what `cdr-fs prune` produces.
# Blank means the combination has no features. The 24 filled cells sum to 99.
# organelle rows and category columns are the display names from
# scripts/categorization/config.ini; the feature -> (category, organelle) lookup that
# produces them is committed alongside as hcs_proc_feature_categories.tsv.
